environment.description: Same EC2 monolith deployed in staging VPC (us-west-2). LaunchDarkly project 'acme-staging' has flag 'report-engine-v2' configured with targeting rule: default variation = true, off variation = true (flag serves 'true' regardless of targeting state or kill switch position due to fallthrough and off-variation both set to variation index 0 which maps to boolean true). The SDK initialization uses streaming mode with 'stale-flags-fallback' wrapper that returns the last known value from DynamoDB cache (TTL 24h) if LD edge goes unreachable — cached value for this flag is also 'true' since initial rollout 90 days ago. No WAF or network-level filtering is applied to this environment.
